content: No... Let's go.

speaker: Bagpipe
content: We need to fetch Reed.

speaker: Fischer
content: —You're very kind to her.

raw: [name="Harmonie"]Of course I would've silenced her. If it wasn't for the Taran next to her.
speaker: Harmonie
content: Of course I would've silenced her. If it wasn't for the Taran next to her.

raw: [name="Harmonie"]Still, if she can make our Draco realize she has nowhere to belong but Dublinn, then that's all the better.
speaker: Harmonie
content: Still, if she can make our Draco realize she has nowhere to belong but Dublinn, then that's all the better.

raw: [name="Fischer"]Your forces seem to have assembled towards my end now.
speaker: Fischer
content: Your forces seem to have assembled towards my end now.

raw: [name="Harmonie"]Indeed. The poor child's fleeing northwest under our pursuit.
speaker: Harmonie
content: Indeed. The poor child's fleeing northwest under our pursuit.

raw: [name="Fischer"]Heh. Much further, and she'll be in the heart of Duke Wellington's domain.
speaker: Fischer
content: Heh. Much further, and she'll be in the heart of Duke Wellington's domain.

raw: [name="Harmonie"]Once she's there, everything she does will be under Dublinn's thumb.
speaker: Harmonie
content: Once she's there, everything she does will be under Dublinn's thumb.

raw: [name="Harmonie"]So the priority right now is... shall we say, dealing with everyone who knows too much.
speaker: Harmonie
content: So the priority right now is... shall we say, dealing with everyone who knows too much.

raw: [name="Harmonie"]In the unlikely event you live to send intel back, it won't be much more than what your death itself would've told them.
speaker: Harmonie
content: In the unlikely event you live to send intel back, it won't be much more than what your death itself would've told them.

raw: [name="Moran"]Selmon, slow down... I'm having trouble keeping up. Where are we?
speaker: Moran
content: Selmon, slow down... I'm having trouble keeping up. Where are we?

raw: [name="Selmon"]Must've run about two hundred meters into the woods, from the camp. Hah. Gave that soldier a good drubbing, now none of them are hounding us.
speaker: Selmon
content: Must've run about two hundred meters into the woods, from the camp. Hah. Gave that soldier a good drubbing, now none of them are hounding us.

raw: [name="Selmon"]Oof... We're safe here. I'll treat my injuries first, then I'll head back and tell everyone to come this way and meet up with you.
speaker: Selmon
content: Oof... We're safe here. I'll treat my injuries first, then I'll head back and tell everyone to come this way and meet up with you.

raw: [name="Selmon"]People with Fionn's naff skills shouldn't be sticking around so long on the battlefield. Ought to be fighters like me.
speaker: Selmon
content: People with Fionn's naff skills shouldn't be sticking around so long on the battlefield. Ought to be fighters like me.

raw: [name="Selmon"]Tch. You're miles better at fighting than he is, too.
speaker: Selmon
content: Tch. You're miles better at fighting than he is, too.

raw: [name="Moran"]...Selmon, there's a huge din behind us. What happened?
speaker: Moran
content: ...Selmon, there's a huge din behind us. What happened?

raw: [name="Moran"]All I can see is... a faint glow.
speaker: Moran
content: All I can see is... a faint glow.

raw: [name="Selmon"]Hah, rotten shame you don't get to see proper. It's the fire from Reed's Arts, no doubt about it.
speaker: Selmon
content: Hah, rotten shame you don't get to see proper. It's the fire from Reed's Arts, no doubt about it.

speaker: Moran
content: Is it a fine sight?

speaker: Selmon
content: Mhm.

raw: [name="Selmon"]But, well, I've known all along she was capable of that.
speaker: Selmon
content: But, well, I've known all along she was capable of that.

raw: [name="Selmon"]...Was night always this cold, out in the wilds...?
speaker: Selmon
content: ...Was night always this cold, out in the wilds...?

raw: [Subtitle(text="Suppose you're willing to light your fire. Will that make it a little warmer... a little brighter?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Suppose you're willing to light your fire. Will that make it a little warmer... a little brighter?

raw: [Subtitle(text="I don't know why you're disappointed in Dublinn, or why they're disappointed in you. The Tarans want to survive. They should survive. It's the simplest logic. How can any of it be a lie?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I don't know why you're disappointed in Dublinn, or why they're disappointed in you. The Tarans want to survive. They should survive. It's the simplest logic. How can any of it be a lie?

raw: [Subtitle(text="Before you leave the group, I need to talk to you about the whole—'going to Dublinn' thing. You'd know the way, right?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Before you leave the group, I need to talk to you about the whole—'going to Dublinn' thing. You'd know the way, right?

raw: [Subtitle(text="Moran, we'll head forward a little more. It'll be safer that way. Don't be afraid. It's all muddy here. If those soldiers retreat, they won't be coming this way.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Moran, we'll head forward a little more. It'll be safer that way. Don't be afraid. It's all muddy here. If those soldiers retreat, they won't be coming this way.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Besides, the sun should be almost up.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Besides, the sun should be almost up.

raw: Their step finally slows. Moran no longer staggers trying to keep up.
content: Their step finally slows. Moran no longer staggers trying to keep up.

speaker: Moran
content: Selmon, are we somewhere safe now?

raw: [name="Moran"]I'm not afraid of bad news... Tell me.
speaker: Moran
content: I'm not afraid of bad news... Tell me.

raw: They walk forward. Amongst the howl of the wind, distant explosions, and the cries, Moran tries her hardest to discern the sound of Selmon.
content: They walk forward. Amongst the howl of the wind, distant explosions, and the cries, Moran tries her hardest to discern the sound of Selmon.

raw: There should've been some forewarning, in that moment. Selmon should've stopped in her tracks, said something. At the very least, a scornful cackle at the fate of the Tarans.
content: There should've been some forewarning, in that moment. Selmon should've stopped in her tracks, said something. At the very least, a scornful cackle at the fate of the Tarans.

raw: But what Moran feels is simple; a step made, and the hand in hers falls, all of a sudden.
content: But what Moran feels is simple; a step made, and the hand in hers falls, all of a sudden.

raw: And she stoops, and cannot tell if what she feels is thick blood or wet mud.
content: And she stoops, and cannot tell if what she feels is thick blood or wet mud.
